title: Crispy Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and crispy Moroccan-inspired vegetable Tagine, perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: Vegetable
ingredients.amount: 1 cup of mixed vegetables (carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)

instructions: In a pan, heat the olive oil and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Moroccan tagine spice blend and stir well.
Roll out the crispy pastry and cut into squares.
Place the vegetable mixture onto one half of each square and brush the edges with water.
Fold the pastry in half and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes or until crispy and golden.
